name: MegaFon
note: Zenit and Krylia Sovetov partner. Shorts sponsor of HC Metallurg Magnitogorsk (МЕГАФОН on the 2026/27 game shorts): logo visible on the season kit render and a 2026-09-06 match photo via the KHL.Marketing kits article on sports.ru; Megafon's own press release of 2026-02-26 confirms the continuing club partnership. Wholly owned by Alisher Usmanov's private USM Holding (claim megafon-usm-ownership); no state stake, no human-rights finding found. Proposed tier: none (see PR).
